metadata.name: Textile Recovery Recommendation Rules
metadata.description: Explainable rule-based recommendations for textile reuse, repair, recycling, upcycling, recovery, donation, and specialized treatment.

rules.name: Hazardous contamination handling
rules.reason: Hazardous contamination requires controlled treatment and must not enter normal reuse or recycling workflows.

rules.name: High contamination handling
rules.reason: High contamination prevents direct reuse and may require cleaning, separation, or specialized industrial processing.

rules.name: Severely damaged textile
rules.reason: Severely damaged textiles are unsuitable for direct reuse but may still contain recoverable fibers.

rules.name: Excellent condition direct reuse
rules.reason: The textile is in excellent condition with minimal contamination and can remain in use without major processing.

rules.name: Good condition donation
rules.reason: The textile remains usable and can be redistributed through donation or resale channels.

rules.name: Repairable textile
rules.reason: The textile has repairable damage and can return to use after minor restoration.

rules.name: Cotton mechanical recycling
rules.reason: Cotton fibers can often be mechanically recovered when the textile is no longer suitable for reuse.

rules.name: Linen mechanical recycling
rules.reason: Linen textiles may be processed through mechanical fiber recovery when reuse is not appropriate.

rules.name: Wool fiber recovery
rules.reason: Wool fibers can be recovered and reused in lower-grade textile applications.

rules.name: Silk reuse and upcycling
rules.reason: Silk has high reuse value and is suitable for creative reuse or upcycling when direct reuse is limited.

rules.name: Denim upcycling
rules.reason: Denim is durable and can be converted into bags, accessories, patchwork products, or home-decor items.

rules.name: Denim mechanical recycling
rules.reason: Severely damaged denim may be shredded and processed for fiber recovery.

rules.name: Polyester chemical recycling
rules.reason: Polyester can be processed through chemical recycling when suitable infrastructure is available.

rules.name: Polyester mechanical recycling
rules.reason: Clean polyester textiles may be processed through mechanical recycling.

rules.name: Nylon chemical recycling
rules.reason: Nylon may be suitable for specialized chemical recycling or polymer recovery.

rules.name: Rayon specialized recycling
rules.reason: Rayon may require specialized fiber recovery depending on its composition and condition.

rules.name: Acrylic industrial recovery
rules.reason: Acrylic recycling options are limited and may require specialized industrial recovery.

rules.name: Mixed fabric material separation
rules.reason: Blended textiles should be separated by fiber composition before selecting a recycling process.

rules.name: Low contamination general upcycling
rules.reason: Textiles that are unsuitable for direct reuse may still be converted into new products.

rules.name: Medium contamination cleaning
rules.reason: The textile should be cleaned before a final recovery pathway is selected.

rules.name: General recyclable textile fallback
rules.reason: The textile is identified as recyclable, but no more specific rule was matched.
